§6Docking Pad§f is the landing counterpart to the Launch Pad. Rockets returning from a Space Station can use a Docking Pad as their return target, and it also serves as the home base for Unmanned Vehicle missions.

Craft it shapeless: 1 Concrete Tile + 1 Tracking Circuit. Like the Launch Pad, it needs a 3x3 air clearance and must be linked to a Space Station Assembler using a Linker.

§cWARNING:§f If a rocket returns to a planet with no Docking Pad or Launch Pad, it lands in a random 3x3 area and may destroy terrain. Always pre-place pads at your destinations.

§ePS:§f The pad pairs with the Launch Pad for two-way rocket traffic. Place at least one pad per destination you plan to visit.
